native_mechanisms: Carry-forward with no reset: one accumulator state persists across all marks, so every fold bears the residue of all prior folds.
Each mark's weight is injected into the already-rotated/accumulated state rather than onto a clean value, so earlier marks bend how later marks land (avalanche by compounding multiplication).
Only the final accumulator value is emitted; all intermediate states and residue are discarded.
core_technique: xxHash64-style hashing: four parallel 64-bit accumulator lanes fed by rotate-xor-input-times-odd-constant rounds over 32-byte blocks, lane merge by rotl(1/7/12/18)+add, tail folding, length injection, and MurmurHash3 fmix64 finalisation.
